integrity: The explicit projection and its norm upper bound were checked in the open-access 2025 paper, and the universal lower bound together with the stated open question were checked in the 2026 paper. The norm-one calculation for the complementary projection was reconstructed directly from the block formula. No independent audit, certification, or experimental evidence is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to discretely represented ideals: finite intersections of maximal ideals and strongly omega-maximal ideals. It does not resolve whether every complemented ideal-null space has complementation constant 2. Because the proof is a short combination of two recent results, an equivalent observation may exist under different terminology or in incompletely indexed literature.
title: Exact complementation constant two for discretely represented ideal-null sequence spaces
